design_status: Source-informed publication review, correction and exact finite extension. Original results and preliminary half-efficacy/two-repeat strict-decoder result were known before this protocol. Not blind, externally preregistered or independently reviewed.
queries: Baseline plus L/C/W cuts. Each scan uses 17 separate x=0 branches with the same post-actuation source snapshot; probes -8 through 8. No evolving probe history.
failure_models: Independent across targets, but one fixed success/failure draw per target reused across attempts
decoders: Bayes optimal under the true known q and failure model
Lossy any-change decoder, retaining a changed value and dropping within-target contradictions
Strict perfect-actuation decoder, requiring every individual attempt to fit one nominal tuple
reference: Enumerate ordered success bits for all five q at one and two attempts, plus q=1/2 at three attempts. Retain all 5,184 latent events at q=1/2, m=2. Zero-valued fields can conceal success bits.
miswire: Nominal L cut actually cuts P, with C and W correct; all 81 cases and all probe signatures checked
calibration: Two newly granted, trusted prepared states (1,0,-1,0) and (0,1,0,-1); five fixed deterministic candidates: no operation or cut L/C/W/P. Same actuator assumed for both preparations and later use. Not provider authentication.
execution_boundary: Offline standard-library enumeration only. No model calls, credentials, operational relay changes, or guard installation. Publication is a separate authorized action.
verification: Both Python modes, reversed enumeration, frozen source and result hashes, fresh extraction; same-author checks only
